summary: Long (11,600 px, 19 blocks) page built as one band per reason: experience, learning, security, systems, staff selection, infrastructure, support and team connection, then a founder message, candidates, team videos, client video and a form. Needs 8 to 10 reason bands with a photo or icons each, a founder message and videos.
